launch_gate.rule: Do not launch any P8 run, and do not occupy any GPU P7 is using, until P7 is confirmed complete. After that, the clean-GPU scheduler convention (two scans >=120s apart, zero processes, <500 MiB) governs GPU selection, with sticky contamination flags and per-run nvidia-smi snapshots (harness/final30k/capture_provenance.py).
launch_gate.cohort: All P8 arms on ONE hardware cohort and the frozen higs-13scene-env (torch 2.9.1+cu128, nvcc 12.8.93, sm_80). Never mix cohorts (docs/hardware.md, SKILL.md section 24).

dataset.scenes: canonical 13-scene layout via baseline_closure/adapters/dataset_adapter.py (mipnerf360 x9, tanksandtemples x2, deepblending x2)
dataset.final_eval: FINAL-30K convention: all cameras at iteration 30000
dataset.resolution: GTDataset resolution='1080p' (target 1920x1080, benchmark_framework.resize_cameras); per-scene effective sizes recorded in provenance

matched_protocol_constants.camera_sequence: frozen per-run camera_sequence.npy (rng = random.Random(42), identical across arms; hash recorded in provenance)
matched_protocol_constants.optimizer: Adam eps=1e-15 (lr=0 groups); xyz expon 1.6e-4 -> 1.6e-6 (delay_mult 0.01, max_steps 30000, scaled by cameras_extent); f_dc 2.5e-3; f_rest 2.5e-3/20; opacity 2.5e-2; scaling 5e-3; rotation 1e-3

gsplat_main.role: modern library baseline under the matched trainer
gsplat_main.wrapper: publication_trainer.py new arm wrapping rasterization() (eps2d=0.1, absgrad=True, tile_size=16, packed=False, rasterize_mode='classic')

b1a.source_commit: gsplat v1.5.3 + true AccuTile (frozen source tree /mnt/storage_pool/liaoyuanjun/gsplat-true-accutile-v153)
b1a.label_if_gates_pass: MATCHED_RENDERER (frozen recipe; eps2d asymmetry vs c0/a0 disclosed per P4)
disclosed_deviations: eps2d=0.1 vs c0/a0 0.3 (P4 MATERIAL_CONFOUND disclosure travels with every table)

c0.source_commit: HiGS frozen worktree (same binary as a0)
c0.env_switch: F9 + SCALAR_ADJOINT + H8-MR on, PX=2, HIGS_BWD_ABSGRAD=1, backward_mode=higs_native

b0.wrapper: P1-validated publication_trainer arm (make_publication_trainer.py P1-P20 fixes) + patches/original-3dgs-seed.patch (--seed 42)
disclosed_deviations: densification statistic is the ORIGINAL method's (signed-grad L2-norm >= 2e-4), not absgrad 8e-4 - forcing absgrad on B0 would not be B0 (wrapper policy, reports/publication/matched-baselines.md)
2D filter form: cov-diag +0.3 hardcoded (irreducible API difference vs gsplat-family arms)

taming_rasterizer.role: Taming 3DGS drop-in exact rasterizer under the matched trainer (densification scheme NOT part of this branch)
taming_rasterizer.wrapper: new publication_trainer arm; API adapter for separate dc/sh channels, extra outputs (num_rendered, bucket_sum), sample-state buffers; dense default optimizer ONLY (sparse_adam excluded - not numerically equivalent)
disclosed_deviations: quaternion normalization removed in forward + dnormvdv commented out in backward (authors claim numerical equivalence; verified by G2, never assumed)

control_matrix.comment: CONTROLLED = identical across arms. DEVIATION(disclosed) = differs, irreducible, disclosure mandatory. An arm with any DEVIATION never carries the strict MATCHED_RENDERER label.

optimizer.taming_rasterizer: CONTROLLED (dense Adam only; sparse_adam forbidden in this arm)

pre_run_gates.G1_integration_smoke: 200-iteration trainer smoke, RC=0, densification active (N grows), per arm wrapper (precedent: P1 integration fixes + smoke)
pre_run_gates.G2_exactness_gate: taming_rasterizer only: forward rel-L2 <= 1e-5 AND backward (all parameter gradients incl. quaternion) rel-L2 <= 1e-3 vs the b0 rasterizer on >=15 randomized configs (H8-MR correctness pattern) + 3-scene 200-iter smoke. FAIL => arm excluded from P8 entirely (reclassify, never force).
pre_run_gates.G3_b0_wrapper_resmoke: b0 wrapper re-smoke only if the binary is rebuilt; otherwise P1 evidence stands
pre_run_gates.G4_build_identity: per-arm build identity JSON: source commit SHA, git describe, .so SHA-256, nvcc/torch versions (convention: b1a_accutile_build_identity.json). Frozen binaries must hash-check UNCHANGED.
pre_run_gates.G5_camera_sequence_identity: camera_sequence.npy SHA-256 identical across all arms of a scene pair

run_matrix.screening: 6 arms x 13 scenes x seed 42 = 78 runs (1-seed screening per statistical protocol)
run_matrix.confirmatory: 3-seed (42/43/44) only for pairs that will carry winner claims (per SKILL.md statistical protocol)
run_matrix.scheduling: file-driven queue via publication_scheduler.py; clean-GPU dynamic selection; sticky contamination flags
run_matrix.pairing: paired same-scene runs scheduled adjacently in time (final30k convention: identical seed-42 camera sequence per pair)

validation: Every run must pass: python baseline_closure/BASELINE_VALIDATION.py --run-dir <dir> --manifest baseline_closure/P8_MATCHED_RENDERER_MANIFEST.json --arm <arm> --scene <scene>. Rejections: wrong source commit / wrong binary / wrong scene / wrong resolution / wrong seed / wrong eps2d / wrong iterations / contamination / NaN-Inf / missing final evaluation.
reporting_rules: Every table carries the per-arm label (MATCHED_RENDERER / MATCHED_RENDERER_WITH_DISCLOSURE) and the per-arm eps2d value.
Any table containing both b1a (0.1) and c0/a0 (0.3) carries the P4 MATERIAL_CONFOUND disclosure sentence verbatim.
b0 and taming rows never appear in a strict MATCHED_RENDERER comparison without their deviation disclosures attached; no winner claims across label tiers without the disclosure.
Wall speedups reported as geomean-of-ratios (section 19); per-scene reduction geomean labeled separately; quality deltas described as within-the-matched-benchmark (section 20).
Final Gaussian count N reported per arm per scene; N ratios geomean labeled separately from wall geomean.
prohibited: Modifying the C0/A0/B1A frozen binaries or their build inputs
Redesigning or re-tuning H8 (P10 is port+correctness only, separate manifest)
Opening new optimization branches during P8
Launching any run before P7 completion
Forcing matched controls onto an arm in a way that changes what the arm IS (e.g. absgrad on b0, sparse_adam on taming)
